text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"This brings back memories... I used to 
spend time here every now and then when I 
was enrolled, too."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Look... you can get a great view of the 
students full of vitality from here.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Forging the path to the "Triple Crown." 
That mission alone was my greatest 
motivation. In the exact same way, 
everyone is staking their own pride on the 
line...

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
I was always squinting at those dazzling 
dreams. And... even now.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. How do the children appear in 
your eyes?"

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Please, delight my ears. Tell me what you 
have seen... in your very own words.
